drc — dose-response curves (R package)

Source: AGENTS.md

Refactored version of Ritz/Baty/Streibig/Gerhard drc. Fits and analyzes dose-response models for continuous, binomial, Poisson, negative-binomial, event-time, and SSD data. Depends: R >= 4.0, MASS; imports car, data.table, dplyr, gtools, multcomp, plotrix, sandwich, scales, lifecycle. Tests: testthat 3e (tests/testthat/test-*.R, ~77 files, ~1 per R file). Vignettes: knitr/rmarkdown. Docs: roxygen2 (markdown) + pkgdown (docs/, _pkgdown.yml). Upstream: hreinwald/drc (this fork, branches dev / main); original DoseResponse/drc. Version lives in DESCRIPTION, NEWS.md, CITATION.cff and is HARD-CODED in R/onAttach.R (startup banner) ON PURPOSE (do not replace with packageVersion()) — bump all together. Purpose/audience: ecotox/bioassay/pharma analysis (EC/ED/NEC estimation, hormesis, SSD, model averaging) with fixes for bugs in the stale CRAN version.

API

  • Fit: drm(formula, curveid=, pmodels=, fct=, type=, robust=, bcVal=, lowerl/upperl=, separate=, logDose=, varcov=, pshifts=), control via drmc(). mrdrm() (model-robust, loess blend), idrm() (per-curve fits, used by separate=TRUE) and drm_legacy() (frozen copy of old drm() for regression tests, test-drm-legacy-match.R) are NOT exported.
  • Exported: all fct constructors, drm drmc ED EDcomp compParm comped maED mselect modelFit noEffect neill.test lin.test mr.test Rsq rss MAX PR backfit searchdrc getInitial getMeanFunctions rdrm simDR relpot yieldLoss isobole mixture CIcomp CIcompX plotFACI confint.basic ED_robust maED_robust bread.drc estfun.drc.
  • getMeanFunctions() only lists a SUBSET (LL, W1, W2, BC, LL2, AR, MM); not CRS/UCRS/NEC/G/LN/L.
  • NEC() base constructor is not in the NAMESPACE export (only NEC.2/3/4).
  • Models (fct=), family -> file: log-logistic LL.2/3/3u/4/5 (+ LL2.* = log(e) param, MM.2/3 Michaelis-Menten, in llogistic.R/llogistic2.R); Weibull W1.*, EXD.2/3 (weibull1.R), W2.*, AR.2/3 (weibull2.R), W2x.*; G.2/3/3u/4 Gompertz; LN.*; L.3/4/5 logistic; hormesis BC.4/5 (Brain-Cousens), CRS.4a-c/5/5a-c/6 + UCRS.4a-c/5a-c (cedergreen.R, ucedergreen.R; alpha = 1/0.5/0.25 for a/b/c; old names ml3a, uml4b, cedergreen aliases deprecated via lifecycle); threshold NEC.2/3/4; FPL.4, gaussian/lgaussian (biphasic), gammadr, baro5, multi2, twophase/threephase; mixture models hewlett, voelund, ursa. Naming: trailing number = #free params; u = upper limit fixed; .2 fixes c=0 and d=upper (default 1, for quantal data); .3 fixes c=0; .4 free b,c,d,e; .5 adds asymmetry f. Param order: b slope, c lower, d upper, e ED50 (or NEC/inflection), f asymmetry/hormesis.
  • Potency: ED(), maED(), ED_robust(), EDcomp(), compParm(), relpot().
  • Selection/GOF: mselect(), anova(), modelFit(), Rsq(), noEffect(), neill.test().
  • S3 on class drc: summary, plot, predict, coef, confint, vcov, residuals, fitted.
  • Diagnostics/robust: cooks.distance, hatvalues, boxcox, sandwich/bread/estfun.
  • Simulation: rdrm(), simDR(), simFct() (coverage of ED CIs).
  • Robust wrappers (R/ED_robust.R): ED_robust()/maED_robust() return a data.table (Estimate, stderr, Lower, Upper, confint_, model, EC), NA row per failed/non-positive level; get_ed_interval() (internal) picks tfls/fls for LL/LN/BC/CRS, delta for W.
  • maED(): AIC-weighted model averaging, interval = "buckland"|"kang"; refits via mselect().
  • MAX(): dose/response at hormetic peak, only for models with maxfct (BC, CRS).

Architecture

  1. drm() (R/drm.R, ~35 KB, one long function) parses formula, curveid, pmodels, weights, Box-Cox; detects control-only curves (conCheck, cm); separate=TRUE -> idrm().
  2. type picks the objective in R/drmEM*.R: continuous -> drmEMls (OLS / robust rho via drmRobust, or GLS with varcov), binomial, Poisson, negbin1/2 (extra dispersion par “O”), event (time-to-event, cumulative), ssd (dose is the response; uses derivx density and censoring). drmEMstandard is NOT reachable from drm() (type has no “standard”). Each returns opfct, optional opdfct1, llfct, vcovfct, parmfct, rvfct.
  3. R/drmOpt.R runs optim() (BFGS default; L-BFGS-B if lowerl/upperl/constr), hessian -> vcov.drc (vcCont Hessian/(2*RSE) with chol fallbacks; vcDisc for non-continuous). Parameters are optimised on a scaled axis (scaleFct, doseScaling, respScaling) and rescaled afterwards. drmc() defaults: maxIt=500, relTol=1e-10, useD=FALSE (analytic derivs OFF by default), errorm=TRUE (non-convergence stops).
  4. Result: S3 drc list (fields e.g. fit, curve, parmMat, indexMat, fct, type, data, dataList, origData, coefficients, pmFct, pfFct, df.residual, objList only for separate fits). Almost every downstream function reads parmMat (curves x params) and indexMat (maps params to coef/vcov positions); keep them consistent.
  5. A model fct is a list: fct, ssfct (self-starter), names, optional deriv1/deriv2/ derivx, edfct, maxfct, inversion, scaleFct, retFct/retFctDx (scaled variants), lowerAs/upperAs/monoton, name, text, noParm, fixed. fixed= collapses parameters (LL.4 -> LL.3). A bare function in fct= is wrapped by fct2list().
  6. Multi-curve: curveid + pmodels (data.frame or formula list) decide shared vs. per-curve parameters (parm2mat inside drm(), modelFunction.R, drmParNames, drmConvertParm). Parameter names are b:curve; pmodels is evaluated in data, else .GlobalEnv.
  7. ED() (ED.drc) calls model edfct(parm, respl, reference, type) -> list(ED, gradient); EDhelper()/absToRel() convert absolute -> relative level and swap p for increasing curves (b<0). type="absolute" uses numerical central-difference gradients (.centralDiffGradient) because analytic ones miss the asymptote chain rule. CIs: delta, fls/tfls (log scale), inv (EDinvreg); vcov.=sandwich for robust SE. Hormesis edfct uses uniroot above the peak. NEC.* edfct is closed-form, e - log(1 - p/100)/b (needs b > 0, else NA); the ED is the dose of a p% drop of (d - c). EDcomp() (createsifct, siInner, fieller) compares ratios of EDs between curves.
  8. mselect() refits via update(object, fct=) for each candidate; columns logLik, IC (AIC), Lack of fit (p), Res var (continuous), optional nested F; modelFit/anova use drmLOFls/drmLOFbinomial.

File conventions (R/, ~130 files)

drm*.R fitting internals; drmEM*.R one per data type; lowercase files (llogistic.R, weibull1.R) are implementations, short uppercase names (LL.4) the exported wrappers; *.ssf.R self-starters; <generic>.drc.R S3 methods. NAMESPACE is hand-maintained (not roxygen-generated): new exports/S3 methods must be added there manually. Code style: legacy quoted-name definitions ("fn" <- function), 4-space indent in old files, newer files (ED.drc, maED, ED_robust, MAX) use roxygen + input validation + tryCatch. Old files may still have misplaced #' roxygen blocks inside function bodies (e.g. drmEM*.R).

Gotchas

  • Self-starters can fail on unusual data; drm() errors “Convergence failed” (errorm=TRUE).
  • drm() na.action and warn options are set via options() with on.exit restore.
  • ED() relative levels must be in ]0,100[ unless bound=FALSE (hormesis).
  • ED.drc sorts curves alphabetically unless names are numeric.
  • drm() return for failed convergence is a list with convergence = FALSE, not a drc.
  • Local scratch/dev scripts live in local_testing/ (not part of the package build).
  • Known data-structure quirk: indexMat may be a vector when few params free; coerce with as.matrix() before column subsetting (fixed in ED/predict).
  • Network/CRAN may be blocked on this laptop (Netskope); prefer offline checks.

Vignettes

  • dose-response-workflow.Rmd — end-to-end on ryegrass: fit, plot, mselect(), maED().
  • nec-models.Rmd — threshold/NEC models, parameter meaning, when to use.
  • package-version-comparative-analysis.Rmd — behavior vs. original CRAN version.

Typical workflow

drm() -> summary()/plot() -> mselect() -> ED()/maED() -> (EDcomp()/compParm() for multi-curve) -> modelFit()/diagnostics -> predict().

UCRS bug: how old vs new drc differ (verified this session)

  • Only fct difference in ucedergreen(): OLD (DoseResponse/drc) returns d - numTerm/denTerm; NEW (hreinwald/drc) returns c + d - numTerm/denTerm (missing lower asymptote +c in the old code; new matches Cedergreen et al. 2005).
  • With all 5 params free (UCRS.5x): both fit the SAME curve, but old c/d estimates are biased upward by ~c (optimizer absorbs the missing term). Relative ED50 and GOF unchanged; wrong numbers appear only for parameter interpretation, absolute-scale quantities (type="absolute" ED, MAX() hormesis), and their SEs.
  • Correction (verified this session): fixing c=0 (UCRS.4x) does NOT by itself make the fitted curves diverge — d/f stay free and the old optimizer still absorbs the missing +c (old & new UCRS.4b fits overlapped, both with distorted d/f). The two fct formulas differ by a constant +c at ANY given parameter vector, so divergence is only VISIBLE when there are no free parameters left to soak up the offset (i.e. evaluate/hold parameters fixed). Evaluated at identical params (e.g. c=25), the old curve sits shifted DOWN by exactly c at every dose.
  • Secondary old-code issues: deriv1 c-column was 1/t3 (should be 1 + 1/t3) and deriv1 was omitted from the return list; edfct used (parm, p, ...) without reference/type.

drc ED/EC50 definition (relative)

ED(fit, p) (relative, reference="control") = dose where f(x) = d - (p/100)*(d - c), i.e. p% of the drop between the fitted asymptotes c (lower) and d (upper) — NOT relative to the hormetic peak (that peak is a separate quantity via MAX()). Verified: UCRS.5b on synthetic data (true anchor e=10) gave ED(50)=10.70, matching an independent root-find. Note: ucedergreen() is natively an increasing U-shaped function; a decreasing 100%->0% curve with low-dose stimulation is the Brain-Cousens case (BC.4/BC.5), not UCRS.
